projects.name: elizaOS/eliza

projects.name: can1357/oh-my-pi
projects.description: ⌥ Coding agent with the IDE wired in. Built by Stencil Labs.

projects.name: go-gitea/gitea
projects.description: Git with a cup of tea! Painless self-hosted all-in-one software development service, including Git hosting, code review, team collaboration, package registry and CI/CD

projects.name: iii-hq/iii

projects.description_zh: 基于 Rust 构建的实时服务编排与可观测工具，方便开发者轻松组合、扩展并实时监控各类服务。

projects.name: unclecode/crawl4ai
projects.description: Open-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Run it yourself, or use Crawl4AI Cloud with one key. Join our Discord https://discord.gg/VuxzM8mtf
projects.description_zh: 面向大语言模型与 AI 智能体的开源网页爬虫，可将任意网页抽取整理为干净、适配 LLM 输入的 Markdown 文本。

projects.name: Bash-it/bash-it
projects.description_zh: 社区驱动的 Bash 命令行增强框架，内置丰富的命令补全、别名、插件与终端主题。

projects.name: sharkdp/fd
projects.description: A simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to 'find'

projects.name: blader/humanizer

projects.name: knadh/listmonk
projects.description: High performance, self-hosted, newsletter and mailing list manager with a modern dashboard. Single binary app.

projects.name: jarrodwatts/claude-hud
